releases.name: Version 1.0.4
releases.body: - You'll never guess what this update is
releases.bodyZh: - このアップデートとは一体何を思っているか、あなたは決して推測できません

releases.name: v1.0.3
releases.body:
- Update to patch 13
- Update to use new Common Camera API
releases.bodyZh:
- パッチ13への更新
- 新しいCommon Camera APIを使用する更新

releases.name: v1.0.2
releases.body: - Improved input handling (pre-emptive OWO recorder writing compatibility)
releases.bodyZh: - 入力処理の改善（予防的なOWOレコーダー書き込み互換性）

releases.name: v1.0.1
releases.body: - Prevent an issue where you'd get locked out of first person
releases.bodyZh: - 最初の一人称でロックアウトされる問題を防ぐ

releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
- Updated to use Common Camera Utility
- Now has all the same third person effects as Third Person Camera
- Fixes issue where camera always had the same FOV as at the start (issue #1)
- Added button prompt
- Hides HUD when using camera
releases.bodyZh:
- Common Camera Utilityを使用するよう更新
- Third Person Cameraと同じ第三人称エフェクトを追加
- カメラが常に開始時と同じFOVを持っていた問題を修正 (問題 #1)
- ボタン提示を追加
- カメラを使用時にHUDを非表示にする

releases.name: v0.1.3
releases.body: Improved controls and added in better 3rd person compatibility

releases.name: v0.1.1
releases.body: Improved initialization (now compatible with Outer Wilds Online).
